meta.title: A line is linked to one PR item at a time, and relinking replaces the old link
gaps: No available operation or library case creates or relinks a line to a PR item.
The setup state with line L linked to PR item P1 cannot be created.
The duplicate-link refusal and its "Reference has already been taken" response cannot be exercised.
No available read operation exposes a line's PR item or the event's PRs, including active versus inactive links.
